## News candidates with source checks

### 1. Dairy cooperative beneficiaries receive ₹68.51 crore
The Bihar Chief Minister Secretariat lists a press release dated **1 November 2026** about taking Bihar's milk, vegetables and fish to national and international markets. Reports on the event say ₹68,51,27,060 was transferred to 1,06,063 beneficiaries through 5,832 dairy producer cooperative societies; an Integrated Command and Control Centre and the Sudha Sampark call centre were also inaugurated.
- Official source listing: https://www.cmo.bihar.gov.in/PressRelease.aspx
- Corroborating report: https://lalluram.com/cm-samrat-chaudhary-transfers-68-crore-to-bihar-milk-producers-sudha/
- Additional report: https://aajkikhabar.com/regional/bihars-milk-vegetables-and-fish-must-be-taken-to-national-and-international-markets-cm-samrat/

### 2. UPYOG portal launched for urban services
The Chief Minister Secretariat's **31 October 2026** press release says the UPYOG portal began with 10 of 19 modules in its first phase and is planned for 264 urban local bodies. Listed services include trade licences, water/sewer connections, building-plan approval and grievance handling.
- Official press release PDF: https://www.cmo.bihar.gov.in/DownloadPressRelease.aspx?id=2863&type=1
- Official press release listing: https://www.cmo.bihar.gov.in/PressRelease.aspx

### 3. BPSC TRE 4.0 — urgent verification pending
Several current recruitment reports state that the fee-payment deadline is **2 November 2026** and the application deadline is **3 November 2026** for 33,320 posts under Advertisement 15/2026. The BPSC notice is linked here, but the original PDF returned a gateway error during this review. Keep this item **out of a “fully verified” social post until the original BPSC notice is successfully checked**.
- BPSC official website: https://bpsc.bihar.gov.in/
- Official application portal: https://bpsconline.bihar.gov.in/
- Linked BPSC notice PDF (not fetched successfully in this review): https://bpsc.bihar.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/BPSC_content/Notices/Image_125_BPSC-20261026-l3wn9q.pdf
- Corroborating report: https://indianexpress.com/article/education/bpsc-extends-tre-4-0-application-deadline-november-3-how-to-apply-bpsconline-bihar-gov-in-10941590/

### 4. Madhubani recruitment caution
The district recruitment page lists the KGBV Class IV interview notice with an end date of **31 October 2026**. Do not advertise it as an open vacancy on 2 November.
- Official source: https://madhubani.nic.in/notice_category/recruitment/

## Approval gate
- Review the exact image and caption preview first.
- Ask the user for explicit **OK** for that exact post.
- **HOLD** means stop; do not publish.
- A GitHub file upload is not a Facebook or Instagram publication.
- Do not rerun the previous combined publisher blindly: its 31 October run failed with HTTP 403 at the Facebook Page photo endpoint. The script publishes to Instagram before attempting Facebook, so the Instagram outcome must be checked independently before any retry.
